name: Mitsugi (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Mitsugi town emblem in white: a thin ring with a small stylised character at the top.
history: Flag of the former town of Mitsugi in Hiroshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-28. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.

features.role: Mitsugi town emblem — a thin ring with a small stylised character at the top
